main.name: ATCR hold
main.description: A hold's permissioned space. The hold is the space authority and the only writer; readers are its crew (private hold) or any sailor with a valid delegation token (public hold). Every record the hold authors about a sailor lives here: crew membership, layer inventory, image configs, vulnerability scans and push/pull counts. The hold's public repo keeps only its captain record, its Bluesky posts and its profiles.
